title: Lower bound for Gaussian quadrant probability
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$ and $t\geq 1$. The Gaussian quadrant probability at threshold $t$ is at least the product of the Gaussian quadrant polylogarithmic constant, the standard Gaussian upper tail at $t$ raised to $2/(1+\rho)$, and the reciprocal of $t$ raised to $2-2/(1+\rho)$.
